description: API #14: Diff base RFP/SOW text against SF-30 Solicitation Amendments, SLED Addenda, and official Government Q&A clarification matrices. Flags altered 'shall'/'must' mandates, deadline extensions, CLIN pricing changes, de-facto requirements created by Q&A answers, and invalidated proposal sections with ready-to-paste Shipley redraft language.

amendment_or_qa_text.description: Raw text from one or more SF-30 Solicitation Amendments, SLED Addenda, or official Government Q&A clarification matrices.

base_solicitation_text.description: Raw text from the base RFP, Statement of Work (Section C), Instructions (Section L), Pricing Schedule (Section B), or Evaluation Criteria (Section M).

current_proposal_outline.description: Optional summary of the bidder's existing proposal outline, page budget, or technical baseline to audit for invalidated sections.

name: analyze_rfp_amendment_diff
